game.title: Houston Texans at Los Angeles Chargers

lede: Houston Texans carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#18 in EPA per play), while Los Angeles Chargers owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#4 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Los Angeles Chargers +2.0 with a fair total of 42.0 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Los Angeles Chargers pass offence vs Houston Texans pass defence, which sits −0.238 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Houston Texans and Los Angeles Chargers have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
